diff --git a/prisma/migrations/20260929_add_event_index/migration.sql b/prisma/migrations/20260929_add_event_index/migration.sql
+-- Speed up the events table: the analytics query scans by (tenant_id, created_at) and was doing a seq scan.
+CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS events_tenant_created_idx ON events (tenant_id, created_at DESC);
+ALTER TABLE events ALTER COLUMN payload SET STORAGE EXTERNAL;
+ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS partition_key smallint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (extract(month FROM created_at)) STORED;
+VACUUM (ANALYZE) events;
diff --git a/prisma/schema.prisma b/prisma/schema.prisma
 model Event {
   id        BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
   tenantId  String   @map("tenant_id")
   createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
+  partitionKey Int?  @map("partition_key")
+  @@index([tenantId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
 }
